tasks.description:
Update the Description attribute of the custom field Account_expected_amount on the Account object via Salesforce Setup UI.

- Navigate to Setup → Object Manager → Account → Fields & Relationships → Account_expected_amount → Edit.
- In the 'Description' field, enter the exact approved text: "Expected revenue amount for the account. This field is used for forecasting and reporting."
- Save the changes.
- Do not modify any other field properties (label, type, length, requiredness, etc.).
tasks.rollback_path: If needed, revert the description to its previous value (e.g., empty string) by editing the field again.

tasks.description:
Verify that the field description update was applied correctly.

- Go to Setup → Object Manager → Account → Fields & Relationships → Account_expected_amount.
- Confirm that the Description field displays the exact text: "Expected revenue amount for the account. This field is used for forecasting and reporting."
- Optionally, retrieve the field metadata (e.g., via SFDX force:source:retrieve -m CustomField:Account.Account_expected_amount) and inspect the <description> tag to confirm the change.
- No functional testing is required as this is a UI-only metadata change.
- If the description is correct, mark the task as complete. If not, report the discrepancy.
tasks.rollback_path: If the description is incorrect, re-run TASK-001 with the correct text.
